{{Quote|Edge of the Galaxy&mdash;Family Adventure Pack, the space travel even easy for children. It will bring you and your family dream, hope and a little bit of danger. Rent-a-Speeder is the special feature of this Pack. You can drive and feel the adventure. Don't miss the Solar Heat Power Plant. The state-of-the-art solar technology is there. The newest and most exotic resort which has been just published on the official map at the Edge of the Galaxy. You can stay overnight at the Space Observatory. Your travel agency is of course, Star Tours.|[[Dan Android]] adverting the Family Adventure Package on [[Tourscan]]|<ref name="Star Tours">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>}}
The '''Family Adventure Package''' was a package holiday advertised and sold by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency<ref name="Star Tours" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]]<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> to a new and exotic resort at [[The Edge of the Galaxy]]. It provided accommodations at the [[Rodon Value Pod Hotel]] and activities included touring the [[Solar Power Plant]], [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] picnics, [[Alien/Legends|alien]] get-antiquated parties, and staying overnight at the [[Space Observatory]]. [[Rent-a-Speeder]] was the special feature of this package and there were pet accommodation.<ref name="Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Family Adventure Package was first mentioned in [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], which opened on [[July 12]], [[1989]].<ref name="Star Tours" />
